verdict.rationale: Typesense is a headless search server that can run on any server via Docker, Linux binaries, Kubernetes or Terraform. Its docs include dedicated guides for running tests with Testcontainers and in GitHub Actions, which directly covers CI automation. Missing for 10: the CI guide content beyond its headings (configuration and API-key handling in CI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Running Tests with Testcontainers ... Running Tests in Github Actions
Typesense is an open source search engine that can be downloaded and run from your computer locally or from any server.
Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Mac via Homebrew, Mac Binary, DEB package on Ubuntu/Debian, RPM package on CentOS/RHEL, Linux Binary
